metadata.description: SharePoint site that hosts the three EDD lists. Inheritance is broken on each list, so only the mailbox owner and the builder can open them.
List ID (GUID) of EDD Config: one row of settings plus the watermark.
List ID (GUID) of EDD Action Items: the ledger the dedupe checks read.
List ID (GUID) of EDD Sender Rules: Always / Never rows per address or domain.
Teams user who gets failure and skipped-thread alerts (the builder). Deliberately not read from the Config list, so the alert still sends when Get Config is the action that failed.

inputs.select: @concat('--- Sent ', convertFromUtc(item()?['receivedDateTime'], 'Eastern Standard Time', 'dddd, MMMM d, yyyy h:mm tt'), ' | From: ', item()?['from']?['emailAddress']?['name'], ' <', item()?['from']?['emailAddress']?['address'], '> | To: ', string(item()?['toRecipients']), ' | Cc: ', string(item()?['ccRecipients']), ' | Subject: ', item()?['subject'], decodeUriComponent('%0A'), take(string(item()?['uniqueBody']?['content']), 3000))
@concat('ID ', item()?['ID'], ': ', item()?['Title'], ' | due ', coalesce(item()?['DueDate'], 'none'), ' | status ', item()?['Status']?['Value'])

parameters.item/requestv2/Today: @concat(convertFromUtc(utcNow(), 'Eastern Standard Time', 'dddd, MMMM d, yyyy'), ' (', variables('varToday'), ')')
